name: Houen Levi
source:
"A beat of pleasure and ecstasy flows into my brain! I've never been so overwhelmed before!"

A slightly cringy girl with unique sensibilities, who wanders around in military-style lolita clothing. She chooses to go by "Levi", but it's not her real name. She likes sausages, beer, and potatoes, and believes Germany to be a land loved by God.

Although she appears unemployed at first glance, she works as a composer. She is also good at arranging songs and writing lyrics. When a melody pops into her head, she impulsively starts strumming her guitar without thought for time and place.

She is reserved about sexual matters. She's not uninformed, but music is more important to her. She believes that sexual desire will interfere with her music, so she avoids it.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara3]official website[/url]]
